codeFixes.description: Check onPlaza before sJ for accurate junction identification; force wj=1 inside fitted junction plazas; restrict kerb/off=0 strictly to junction plaza discs (jr + 0.35); allow overlap blending within 0.08 m of asphalt borders.
Snap asphalt boundary vertices (d = +/-hw) to q.y and sink kerb outer vertices (k=2,8) beneath intersecting lower streets whenever adjacent pavement/verge vertices overlap another street.

Cast surface() rays from q.y + 2.2 m to stay below 4.6 m overhead station canopies; add keepLat warp mode and inspection helpers for steep grades, overlapping carriageways, fragmented pavements, local detours, and junction planes.

Apply monotonic pavement taper (321->0 fragmented_pavement), open 168 local one-way detour bottlenecks, smooth remaining steep grades & kinks, trim remaining overlapping carriageways, and align junction samples to fitted planes.
